payload.title: Harden live-host intent fallback and preserve planning status for read commands
payload.description: Defects observed during real L01 Codex trial: MCP approval-blocked calls retried across six methods; a standalone skill read marked the future-planning request in_progress even though its shell never executed. Add bounded authorized fallback guidance and conservative pure-read recognition; publish sanitized actual host evidence without asserting unsupported native-plan, compaction or Claude coverage.
acceptance: Standalone supported pure file reads preserve future backlog; compounds, redirection and executable expressions still take the coordinated work path.
Generated/packaged instructions use only authorized CLI fallback after unavailable MCP, avoid repeated approval-blocked retries and preserve host trust/policy.
Sanitized real Codex failure and successful planning/future/resume/handoff evidence are independently replayable against durable task state.
Unsupported native-plan/compaction delivery and unavailable Claude remain unconfirmed; assertions and fixtures are never labeled live coverage.
